title: The Last Wish
author: Andrzej Sapkowski
summary: Geralt of Rivia is a witcher, a mutant monster hunter who sells his sword to anyone who pays. Stories of his contracts are stitched together around his recovery in a temple, each one twisting a familiar fairy tale.
readIf: you like grim, sardonic fantasy with a world-weary hero and monsters who are not always the villain.
skipIf: you want a single continuous plot, since this is a collection of linked short stories.

pairings.reason: Another charismatic, cynical protagonist in a hard world, with banter and clever schemes.
Shares moral ambiguity and black humour, but is a single connected novel with a large cast.
A fantasy that also pokes at familiar tropes, but with broad comedy in place of grim cynicism.
